label: Opening Hook
text: In 1941, German troops dismantled a palace room made of amber and shipped it away, and it has not been seen since 1945.
title: File:Catherine Palace interior - Amber Room (2).jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Created in Prussia in the early 18th century and given to Peter the Great in 1716 Installed in the Catherine Palace near St Petersburg; said to contain several tonnes of amber Dismantled by German forces in 1941 and displayed in Konigsberg Castle Disappeared in 1944-45; it may have been destroyed by bombing or fire, but its fate is unknown A reconstruction was completed in 2003
